comment: The artefact format this plugin's tools expect, so the health check can compare it against what
MANIFEST.md says the dump actually wrote. The number is owned by the commandlet - the constant
kArtefactFormatVersion in AgentMemoryDumpCommandlet.cpp - and this file mirrors it for the
PowerShell side, which cannot read a C++ constant. tools/check_artefact_format.py fails the
repository when the two drift, because a stamp nobody compares is decoration.
Bump it when a change would make an older artefact set wrong rather than merely smaller: a column
that moves, a file that stops being written, a meaning that changes. Not for a new file or row.

history.what: First stamped format. Sets written before this carry no format row at all, which is how they are recognised.
